title: Better With Time: Dormant Soulforge
description: This adds the Dormant Soulforge from Better Than Wolves to Better With Time.
body:
The Dormant Soulforge spawn in the lava rooms in Nether Fortresses.

It can be made into a Soulforge with Netherite Ingots and a Nether Star.

This makes the Better With Time gameplay more accurate to Better Than Wolves and I though it was a fun thing to add!

So yes this is an (unofficial) Better With Time addon! Soooooo download it please?
